scenes.headline: How Naive-N0.5-Flash skips full attention
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Gideon! Let me show you how Naive-N0.5-Flash runs a million-token context without ever doing full attention.

scenes.text: Every layer is a 128-token window or a top 2,048 sparse pick. No layer does dense global attention.
scenes.mark: No layer does dense global attention
scenes.say: Here's the trick. Each layer reads only a little. A short window, or a sparse pick of keys. No layer reads everything.

steps.say: The context can grow all the way to a million tokens.
Thirty-nine layers are sliding windows. Each one reads only the last 128 keys.
Nine layers are sparse. An indexer keeps the top 2,048 keys, and only those are read.
So no layer ever reads all million. Per token the work stays near twenty-three thousand keys, and flat.

scenes.title: Two cheap layers, never a dense one

steps.label: SWA window 128
steps.say: A window layer sees only a few tokens back.

steps.label: DSA top 2,048
steps.say: A sparse layer scores every key, then keeps just the best ones.
What you never see is a dense layer reading the whole square.

scenes.label: cheaper at 1M than keeping full-attention layers
scenes.say: Keep those nine layers dense instead, and at a million tokens they would read about four hundred times more. That is the whole saving.

scenes.label: single-stream decode, eight GPUs
scenes.note: one DSA layer fused from 29 kernels to 1
scenes.say: Their runtime, NaiveRT, decodes it at a reported two thousand one hundred twenty-two tokens a second, fusing a whole sparse layer into one kernel.

scenes.quote: AI explored and designed its hybrid attention architecture while optimizing its training, inference, and deployment systems. Human researchers provided guidance and made key decisions.
scenes.say: The lab says AI designed the architecture and built the runtime, while humans set direction and made the key calls. A claim about process, not proof.

scenes.text: Drop dense attention entirely, and a frontier model's million-token context becomes a fixed cost, not a runaway one.

scenes.say: No dense layers. Thirty-nine windows, nine sparse pickers, and a million-token context that stays cheap.
